verdict.rationale: Groq publishes an official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK under its own GitHub org (groq/groq-typescript) that wraps its REST API, with documented usage such as audio transcription and file uploads. That is the product's own first-party SDK, so the story's core is met. Only one language SDK is evidenced, though, and the docs otherwise lean on OpenAI's client libraries via base_url swapping, which is compatibility rather than an official Groq SDK. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in other languages (e.g., a first-party Python SDK), first-party docs pages dedicated to the SDKs, an OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404 on all candidate paths), and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: This library provides convenient access to the Groq REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.
Request parameters that correspond to file uploads can be passed in many different forms
